name: Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Risk checklist for NDAs and confidentiality agreements.

categories.name: Definition of confidential information
categories.description: Flag overly broad definitions that include publicly available information, or definitions so vague that nearly any information qualifies as confidential.

categories.name: Obligations and restrictions
categories.description: Flag one-sided obligations where only one party is bound, restrictions on discussing the existence of the relationship, or obligations that survive indefinitely.

categories.name: Duration
categories.description: Flag confidentiality periods longer than 3 years for general business information (trade secrets may warrant longer), or indefinite terms with no expiration.

categories.name: Exceptions and carve-outs
categories.description: Flag missing standard exceptions for independently developed information, legally compelled disclosure, or information that becomes public through no fault of the receiving party.

categories.name: Return or destruction of information
categories.description: Flag requirements to return or destroy all copies with no exception for legally required retention, or no provision for what happens to information at termination.

categories.name: Remedies and damages
categories.description: Flag liquidated damages clauses with disproportionate penalty amounts, or provisions allowing injunctive relief without proving actual harm.
